quickSummary: Mitosis is equational division yielding 2 genetically identical diploid (2n) daughter cells. Prophase condenses chromatin and moves centrosomes toward opposite poles. Animals form amphiastral spindles with radiating asters; higher plants form anastral spindles lacking asters. In Prometaphase, the nuclear envelope completely breaks down and trilaminar kinetochores attach to spindle fibers. At Metaphase, chromosomes align on the equatorial plate, providing optimal morphology for karyotyping.

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Animal mitosis = Amphiastral (asters present). Plant mitosis = Anastral (no asters). Metaphase is the best stage for karyotyping and chromosomal morphology analysis.

conceptBreakdown.content: Mitosis is an **equational division** in which a single parental somatic cell ($2n$) divides into two genetically identical daughter cells ($2n$).

conceptBreakdown.heading: 3.1 Prophase & Spindle Architecture
conceptBreakdown.title: 3.1 Prophase & Spindle Architecture
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
MITOTIC SPINDLE TYPE COMPARISON
                     
      AMPHIASTRAL SPINDLE (Animals)            ANASTRAL SPINDLE (Higher Plants)
      ├── Asters present at poles             ├── Asters ABSENT
      └── Organized by Centrosomes            └── Organized by non-centrosomal MTOCs
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Prophase**: Progressive condensation of chromatin fibers into distinct double-chromatid chromosomes. Centrosomes migrate toward opposite poles.
• **Amphiastral vs Anastral**:
  - **Amphiastral Spindle (Animal Cells)**: Centrosomes radiate microfilaments called **Asters** at both spindle poles.
  - **Anastral Spindle (Higher Plants)**: Lacks asters and centrioles; spindle is organized by diffuse non-centrosomal microtubule organizing centers (MTOCs).
• **Prometaphase**: Complete breakdown of the nuclear envelope; **trilaminar protein discs called Kinetochores** assemble at the centromere.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 3.2 Metaphase & Spindle Fiber Types
conceptBreakdown.title: 3.2 Metaphase & Spindle Fiber Types
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
METAPHASE SPINDLE FIBERS
                         
   Kinetochore Microtubules ──► Connect spindle poles directly to Kinetochores.
   Polar Microtubules       ──► Extend from poles to overlap at equator.
   Astral Microtubules      ──► Radiate outward from centrosomes to cell cortex.
conceptBreakdown.content:
• Chromosomes reach maximal condensation and align along the equatorial plane forming the **Metaphase Plate**.
• *Chromosome morphology, size, and karyotype are best observed and measured at Metaphase*.
